name: payloadforge
description: Offline developer toolkit for API payloads.

scripts.check: node --check web/assets/js/app.js && node --check web/sw.js && node --check scripts/build-site.mjs && node --check scripts/compare-visual-baselines.mjs && node --input-type=module --eval "import('./packages/core/index.js')"
scripts.check:extensions: npm run sync:core && node --check browser-extension/popup.js && node --check browser-extension/background.js && node --check vscode-extension/src/extension.js && node --input-type=module --eval "import('./browser-extension/core/index.js'); import('./vscode-extension/core/index.js')"
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run check:extensions && npm test
